prefix.description: The IPv6 prefix portion that npd6 will match on for neighbor solicitations.

interface.description: The network interface to monitor and use for the neighbor proxy.

ralogging.description: Enable Router Advertisement logging. 'on' logs prefix info at INFO level.

listtype.description: List type for filtering NS requests. 'none', 'black', or 'white'.

listlogging.description: Enable logging of list matches when using black or white lists.

collectTargets.description: Number of targets to collect target data for. 0 to disable.

linkOption.description: Set to true to enable target link-layer option on replies to unicasted NS.

ignoreLocal.description: If true, ignore NS for the local interface and let the kernel reply.

routerNA.description: If true, set the ROUTER flag in outbound Neighbor Advertisements.

maxHops.description: Maximum number of hops for Neighbor Advertisements. Should usually remain 255.

pollErrorLimit.description: Number of consecutive poll errors before terminating the process.
